description: Up to three interventional ClinicalTrials.gov studies matching an asset or target AND an oncology indication, side by side: sponsor, phase, status, declared arms, primary outcomes, last update, registry URL. Active studies first, then later phase; different sponsors where possible. Use a target (e.g. "KIF18A", "B7-H3") rather than one drug name to see other programmes.

asset.description: Public asset or target, e.g. "sotorasib", "KRAS G12C", "B7-H3".

name: compare_trials
title: Compare trials around an asset
